generation_notes: Generated four VK-only Modbus/TCP candidate sequences from the supplied plans. Each sequence preserves its assigned target_operation and uses conservative MBAP framing with internally consistent length and count fields. The set emphasizes distinct operations, state shapes, unit identifiers, addresses, and payload sizes while keeping issue-supported relations such as repeated write activity, minimal valid requests, and field interaction patterns. No exact historical crash payloads were copied.

Keeps requests mutation-friendly while avoiding exact reproduction of cited crash byte streams.
